The '''All Planets Market''' was an open-air market held in a large plaza located in the shadow of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Built in the last century of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the market provided the citizens of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] with [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] and vegetables from all around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
